dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam! How was your meeting with the investor?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm! ˈhaʊ wʌz jʊr ˈmiːtɪŋ wɪð ði ɪnˈvɛstər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Good, I think. He liked our idea, but he wants to see a better business plan.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd, aɪ ˈθɪŋk. hiː ˈlaɪkt aʊər aɪˈdiːə, bʌt hiː ˈwɑːnts tə ˈsiː ə ˈbɛtər ˈbɪznəs ˌplæn.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's good news. Investors only ask for more when they're interested.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈɡʊd ˈnuːz. ɪnˈvɛstərz ˈoʊnli ˈæsk fər ˈmɔːr wɛn ðɛr ˈɪntrəstɪd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I hope so. Ploy and I want to be real entrepreneurs, not just students with a start-up.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈhoʊp ˈsoʊ. ˈplɔɪ ənd aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə bi ˈriːəl ˌɑːntrəprəˈnɜːrz, ˈnɑːt ˈdʒʌst ˈstuːdənts wɪð ə ˈstɑːrtʌp.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Lots of entrepreneurs started as students. So, what does he want to see?
dialogue.reading: ˈlɑːts əv ˌɑːntrəprəˈnɜːrz ˈstɑːrtɪd əz ˈstuːdənts. soʊ, ˈwʌt dʌz hiː ˈwɑːnt tə ˈsiː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: More numbers about our costs. And he suggested that we do more market research.
dialogue.reading: ˈmɔːr ˈnʌmbərz əˈbaʊt aʊər ˈkɔːsts. ənd hiː səɡˈdʒɛstɪd ðæt wiː ˈduː ˈmɔːr ˈmɑːrkɪt rɪˌsɜːrtʃ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I agree. I'd recommend that you ask at least a hundred students what they want.
dialogue.reading: aɪ əˈɡriː. aɪd ˌrɛkəˈmɛnd ðæt juː ˈæsk ət ˈliːst ə ˈhʌndrəd ˈstuːdənts ˈwʌt ðeɪ ˈwɑːnt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Ploy suggested that we reduce our prices, too. What do you think?
dialogue.reading: ˈplɔɪ səɡˈdʒɛstɪd ðæt wiː rɪˈduːs aʊər ˈpraɪsɪz, ˈtuː. ˈwʌt duː juː ˈθɪŋk?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I suggest that you wait. Do the research first, and then decide.
dialogue.reading: aɪ səɡˈdʒɛst ðæt juː ˈweɪt. ˈduː ðə ˈriːsɜːrtʃ ˈfɜːrst, ənd ˈðɛn dɪˈsaɪd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Good idea. Could you look at our business plan before we send it?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd aɪˈdiːə. kʊd juː ˈlʊk ət aʊər ˈbɪznəs ˌplæn bɪˈfɔːr wiː ˈsɛnd ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Of course. I used to be an accountant, remember? And I recommend that Ploy check the numbers, too.
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs. aɪ ˈjuːst tə bi ən əˈkaʊntənt, rɪˈmɛmbər? ənd aɪ ˌrɛkəˈmɛnd ðæt ˈplɔɪ ˈtʃɛk ðə ˈnʌmbərz, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thanks, Mr. Brown! You'd make a great investor yourself!
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks, ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn! juːd ˈmeɪk ə ˈɡreɪt ɪnˈvɛstər jʊrˈsɛlf!
